summary_zh.motivation: 研究TiB2增强Inconel 625复合材料的SLM制备与性能

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the microhardness and microstructure evolution of TiB2 reinforced Inconel 625 composite produced by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: The composite was fabricated by selective laser melting with varying TiB2 content, followed by microstructural characterization and microhardness testing.
summary_en.result: TiB2 addition refined the microstructure and increased microhardness, with optimized distribution improving mechanical properties.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through microhardness measurements and SEM/EDS analysis of the as-built composites.
